data.name: PasskeysDescription
data.value: Add or remove passkeys here to simplify how you access your account using biometrics or screen locks. Passkeys provide a safer alternative to passwords by protecting you against phishing and data breaches. Use this list to manage the specific devices you've authorized for instant entry. Please note that removing a passkey from ViciOne only revokes its access and will not delete the credential from your personal authenticator or password manager.
